Pricing

NMark Designs / Nikola Marković

A website that feels professional, built through a clear and grounded process.

NMark Designs is the name I use for website design, development and maintenance work for small businesses, service providers and projects that need a clean, fast and clear online presence.

Working Approach

No big-agency theatre. The focus is a website that actually makes sense for your work.

I am Nikola Marković, a frontend developer who brings design, content structure and technical implementation together into one usable website.

I usually work with people who do not want a generic page, but also do not need a complicated process with layers of middlemen. The important part is to understand each other quickly, make good decisions and build something that can serve for a long time.

In practice, that means clear content hierarchy, careful visual rhythm, loading speed, SEO fundamentals and a structure that can grow later without rebuilding the entire site.

NMark Designs is therefore not presented as a large company, but as a recognizable frame for my work: direct communication, thoughtful design and technical execution without unnecessary complexity.

How Collaboration Works

A good website does not start with effects. It starts with understanding who it speaks to, what it needs to explain and which next step the visitor should take.

  • 01First we clarify the website goal, audience and most important content.
  • 02Then we shape a structure that guides visitors without friction.
  • 03The design stays clean, professional and connected to the project's identity.
  • 04The build is handled so the website is fast, responsive and easier to maintain.

If you want a website that feels serious rather than template-made, we can talk.
